senses.definition: An early lossless image compression standard developed by the JBIG, widely implemented in fax machines.
senses.example: The JBIG format works well with the many common bilevel images that include text and line art.

senses.definition: A hard disk enclosure for several disks, especially one lacking a RAID controller.
Just be white (used sardonically to reflect the belief that white men are greatly advantaged over other men at attracting women)
senses.example: ‘JBW’ or ‘Just Be White’—the idea that being white automatically makes you more attractive, particularly to non- white women
